title: StationSWERegressionV2: linear regression model for daily gridded snow water equivalent
description:
R package and analysis code for the linear regression model (LRM) of daily gridded snow water equivalent used in Yang et al. (2022), Advances in Water Resources 160, 104075. Each day an elastic-net regression is trained on snow pillow SWE, with these predictors: physiographic variables, a historical SWE pattern from snow reanalysis, and MODIS fractional snow-covered area. The model is then applied to every grid cell.

The release has two parts:

  • The R package.
  • The paper folder (paper/Yang2022_AWR). It holds the model runs, the scripts for Figs. 3–11, the data-release scripts, and the original 2020 scripts.

It builds on stationsweRegression by Dominik Schneider (MIT).
